pricesIntro: A retained fee preview, with every assumption visible before you commit.
buyingTitle: Ready to buy, not yet paid.
buyingIntro: Review a real reservation and prepare a private offer draft. No payment or offer is sent here.
sampleInfo: Buyer fee 3%, seller commission 5% of watch price. Collected fees are never refunded. Shipping and tax are zero only in this preview; actual charges need separate disclosure. No currency conversion is applied.
subject: Watch or subject reference
commissionBasis: Seller commission is calculated on watch price, excluding buyer fee, shipping and tax.
reviewed: Exact version acknowledged — not a payment
emptyQuotes: No fee previews yet. Save a preview to keep its exact version.
reviewCurrent: This quote is expired or has changed. Create and review a new preview; the old version is retained.
invalidMoney: Enter US dollars with at most two decimal places and no thousands separators.
invalidReference: Enter a valid reference and a positive whole revision.
notBinding: A fee preview never reserves a watch or authorizes a charge. Confirm current listing terms before any commitment.
verifiedSource: Current listing price verified · not reserved
bindingUnavailable: The order’s exact fee reference is unavailable. No substitute preview is used.
signInBody: Your prices, inbox and offer drafts are private to your account.
unauthorized: Sign in to see your private records.
forbidden: This action is not available to this account.
unavailable: This service is unavailable or no confirmation was received. Check your saved records before retrying.
conflict: The record changed or the request no longer matches. Reload and review the current version.
checkFields: Check the reference, amount and revision fields.
routeInfo: Simulated card, Whish Money and OMT Pay are the permitted methods. Payment availability must be confirmed by the order.
noCommitment: Saving this draft sends nothing to the seller and creates no accepted offer or paid order.
reservationInfo: A reservation is not a payment, receipt, authentication pass or payout.
quoteMissing: Choose a retained preview to see its exact fees.
notificationPending: Payment notification pending. No payment clock is confirmed. Contact support if this remains unresolved for 24 hours.
deadlineUnavailable: The payment deadline is unavailable. Reload the current order before continuing.
paymentClock: Payment time starts with the durable buyer notice: 24 hours for simulated card; 48 hours for Whish Money, OMT Pay or no selection. Switching method keeps the same start time. Unknown payment remains held for review.
